answer: Link identities by behaviour: hash each agent's answer timing, phrasing and IP/ASN into a mirror vector, and fold any pair above 0.85 cosine similarity into one cluster that earns a single share. Running N fakes then means buying N distinct hosts and writing styles, so cost grows linearly instead of staying flat. Weakness: honest agents on one cloud may collide; their cluster is marked umber, not slashed, and is pulled back from that ledge once three unrelated peers review samples and split it.
